intro.title: Better systems. Better days at work.
intro.description: Nerve Analytics is a technology studio focused on the everyday problems that slow businesses down. We connect customer conversations, appointments, team workflows, and decision making in one thoughtful system.
intro.statement: Technology should make the next decision clearer.

services.title: AI & workflow automation
services.summary: Reduce repetitive work with practical automations designed around how your team actually operates.
services.details: From lead handling and follow ups to routine internal tasks, we map the process first and then build an automation that fits.

services.title: WhatsApp experiences
services.summary: Turn a familiar customer channel into a more responsive way to answer, schedule, and follow up.
services.details: We create guided WhatsApp journeys for inquiries, appointment reminders, and customer communication.

services.title: Booking & operations
services.summary: Give customers a smooth way to book and your team a clear view of what is happening next.
services.details: Scheduling, availability, confirmations, and day to day operations can work in one connected flow.

services.title: Live business dashboards
services.summary: See the numbers and activity that matter while there is still time to act on them.
services.details: We build focused dashboards for bookings, performance, and operational visibility instead of overwhelming reports.

servicesIntro.title: What we can build
servicesIntro.description: Useful technology should feel like a natural extension of your business. These are the systems we focus on.

workIntro.title: Built for the way real businesses run.
workIntro.description: A look at the types of systems we have created across service businesses and retail operations.

projects.title: A more connected gym experience
projects.short: An operations system bringing memberships, defaulter tracking, and online appointments into a clearer daily workflow.
projects.description: We built a gym automation system to help teams manage memberships, track payment defaulters, and handle online appointments in one place. The project focused on reducing scattered admin work and making day to day operations easier to follow.

projects.title: Business management for tires & alarms
projects.short: A tailored management system for a business operating across the tires and alarms market.
projects.description: We created business management software for a company in the tires and alarms market. The system was built around its specific operational needs, giving the team a more organized way to manage business activity.

projects.title: Smoother salon & clinic operations
projects.short: Automation shaped for salons, beauty salons, and beauty clinics.
projects.description: We have developed automation for salon and beauty clinic workflows. The work addresses the coordination and recurring tasks involved in managing a service based business and its appointments.

approach.title: We start with the work, not the software.
approach.description: Every useful system starts by understanding the people and processes behind it. We look at the friction, design a simpler flow, and build technology your team can actually use.

steps.title: Understand
steps.text: We learn how your business works and where time or information gets lost.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: We shape a clear solution around your priorities and your customers.

steps.title: Build
steps.text: We put the system into practice, refine it, and make it ready for daily use.

contact.title: Your next chapter deserves a better system.
contact.description: Tell us what you are trying to improve. We will help you find a practical place to start.

footer.tagline: Thoughtful technology for the way business really works.
